Shri Justice Vinay Saraf

On The 9 th Of June, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 24651 of 2025
 Naveen Singh Patel
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Trilok Chand Jain - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Vijay Gulani - Advocate for Objector.
 Shri Virendra Khadav - Ga for State.
 Order

This is first bail application under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail filed by the applicant in connection with Crime No.553/2021, registered at Police Station - Kasrawad, Distt. Khargone for offence punishable under Sections 420, 409, and 120B of IPC.
Applicant is in custody since 23.4.2025.

The prosecution case in brief is that the complainant opened an account at the Kiosk operated by co-accused Arif and lateron he received a notice from the bank that he has obtained a loan of Rupees seven lakh.
As per the complainant he never obtained any loan and not received the amount.

He moved an application u/S.156 (3) of Cr.P.C. FIR was registered against Arif and after investigation,
the charge sheet was filed against Arif.

However, during investigation it was revealed that the bank Manager Vikram 2 MCRC-24651-2025 Singh was involved in the case and the loan amount, which was sanctioned in the name of the complainant was not disbursed to him and misappropriated.
Upon the memorandum of co-accused, present applicant has been implicated in the case and arrested on 23.4.2025.
Counsel for applicant submits that the applicant had no connection with the complainant and the complainant had not named the applicant in the FIR.

The applicant has been implicated on the basis of memorandum of co- accused upon the allegation that the co-accused has transferred Rs.50,000/-
in the account of the applicant.
He further submits that the investigation is over and the charge sheet has already been filed against the applicant, and prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
Counsel for Objector - complainant opposed the bail application on the ground that the applicant along with other co-accused persons conspired and committed cheating with the complainant.
He further submits that the bail application of co-accused Arif has been dismissed and the bail application of Vikram Singh is pending.
He prays for dismissal of the application.

sentences.text: Govt. Advocate also opposed the bail application.

Considering the fact that the applicant has been implicated on the basis of memorandum of co-accused and no amount was transferred from the account of complainant to the account of the applicant, the applicant is in custody since 23.4.2025 and the trial will take considerable time for disposal as well as
Considering the allegations levelled against the applicant, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail during the trial.
The case of the applicant is different from the case of co-accused Arif and Vikram.

It is directed that applicant shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
The applicant shall appear before the trial Court on all the dates fixed by the trial Court without any default during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480 (3) of BNSS.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial, however, in case of bail jump and / or breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
Certified copy, as per rules.
